limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and the technical source reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.
The walkthrough ran on the shared work2 lab (openlaw-docs-80ceef9e-work2) while other agents used it. List, Home and calendar checks looked only for this run's own DOC-030 contracts-b records.

Prerequisite records and supporting actions used the API as the acting or other staff role: Contract creation, team changes (including the recipient who leaves the team), extra Tasks and Key dates for the ordering, Next deadline and Home checks, deleting the Task comment before the second removal attempt, and archive/restore around the read-only check. Every action the guide instructs was done in the browser.
The partial-save case used a browser route that answered one comment POST with 503. It proves the dialog's handling, not a real storage outage.

Reminder email, Portal bell and daily summary delivery and timing were not exercised; notifications.md owns those rules. The checks covered the saved lead times, the Recipients selection, the departed-recipient notice and the personal Reminder lead times card.

The personal Reminder lead times list was changed for the acting person and put back to its starting value (the organization default) in the same step. The Legal Team Member's Contracts list view was switched to Default view to read Next deadline and then re-selected.
The API still exposes PUT /contracts/:number/tasks/reorder. The walkthrough did not call it; a mouse drag on the Tasks section sent no reorder request and changed nothing.

An earlier full run (walkthrough-attempt1.json) failed only its Business User steps, because the shared lab's sign-in link budget answered 429. The recorded run signed the Business User in once before the walk.
Browser: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium, headless, one context per identity at 1280x1600 CSS px; default theme only; no narrow layout, keyboard-only or assistive technology check.
